summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation, stock reservation, and priority fulfillment.

requirements.description: Stock reservation for an order must be all-or-nothing, atomically deducting stock only when all line items (with quantities aggregated across duplicate SKUs) are available.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: Current warehouse stock and an order containing multiple line items with possible duplicate SKUs
acceptance.when: Reservation is attempted for the order
acceptance.then: All line items are reserved together if stock is sufficient for the aggregated quantities; otherwise, no stock is deducted and an insufficient_stock reason is returned

requirements.description: Orders marked as expedited must be processed before normal priority orders, preserving the original relative order within each priority tier.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: A list of orders with a mix of expedited and normal priorities
acceptance.when: The orders are fulfilled against available stock
acceptance.then: Expedited orders are allocated stock first in arrival order, followed by normal orders in arrival order

requirements.description: Each order ID is processed at most once: the first occurrence claims the ID, and any subsequent orders with the same ID are completely ignored.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: A sequence of incoming orders containing duplicate order IDs
acceptance.when: Orders are ingested and evaluated for fulfillment
acceptance.then: Only the first occurrence of each order ID is processed, and subsequent occurrences with the same ID are ignored

requirements.description: Orders with invalid lines or invalid configurations must be rejected without mutating stock or any input data objects.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: Input stock and order objects, potentially containing invalid lines or formats
acceptance.when: Reservation or order fulfillment is executed
acceptance.then: Invalid lines or orders are rejected without altering stock levels or mutating any input objects

assumptions: Stock is provided as a plain object mapping nonempty SKU strings to nonnegative safe integers.
Order lines specify positive safe-integer quantities for nonempty SKU strings.
Orders require a nonempty string id, valid priority ('expedited' or 'normal'), and a lines array.
Neither stock nor order objects passed by callers are mutated during execution.
